evidence.quote: would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.
report sea surface temperatures, thermal stress on coral, and bathymetry

criteria.reasoning: Identifies GBR coral monitoring, users, need and references, but objectives and design requirements such as resolution, revisit, latency, coverage and data products are not quantified or complete.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart.

criteria.reasoning: Gantt/timetable with task details and deadlines; information sources are listed. However there is no explicit contingency or variation planning and limited direct linkage to mission technical drivers, so the plan is feasible but not robust.
Only background reading and completion of STK tutorials are reported; no design calculations, trade studies or simulation outputs. This is minor useful progress, not preliminary technical results.

Clear headings and readable prose; the Gantt is legible but lacks a figure caption/number. Footnotes support the first section, but the Useful Links are uncited and reference formatting is inconsistent.

technical_issues.issue: No measurable mission/design requirements are given: orbit, revisit, spatial/spectral resolution, latency, coverage, data rate and payload are undefined.
Assumes satellite detection of seafloor colour/tone changes using an Asner-style system without water-column, atmospheric-correction or sensor-resolution feasibility trade.
No actual STK results or launch/orbit calculations are presented; tutorial completion is not design evidence.
Ground-control statement that one station may suffice for Australia ignores coverage, contact duration and near-real-time latency requirements.
End-of-life option 'leaving it where it is' is not compliant with space-debris mitigation; deorbit or graveyard orbit must match the chosen orbit.
The plan lacks contingency allowance and does not explicitly confirm STK licensing/software arrangements.

overall: A readable preliminary concept with clear GBR rationale, users, Gantt plan and sources, but weak on formal requirements, mission-design calculations and actual STK results. It meets the concept and planning brief adequately; technical progress and presentation need strengthening.
